description: Deep profile for a single coin: description, categories, genesis date, homepage/whitepaper/repo/social links, full market data (price, cap, supply, ATH/ATL, multi-window price change), developer activity (GitHub stars/forks/commits), community stats, and sentiment vote split. The full picture for "tell me everything about Ethereum". The id must be a CoinGecko slug (resolve tickers with coingecko_search_coins). Use sections to fetch only part of the large record. Note: categories here are display names (e.g. "Layer 1 (L1)"), not the category_id slugs from coingecko_list_categories.

id.description: CoinGecko slug (e.g. "ethereum"). Not a ticker — resolve with coingecko_search_coins.

sections.description: Subset of sections to return: profile, market, links, developer, community, sentiment. Omit for all sections.

vs_currency.description: Currency for market prices, cap, ATH/ATL, and every percentage-change window. Single currency; defaults to "usd". Missing quotes remain absent for supported currencies. Ignored when market is not selected.

name: coingecko_get_coin

community.description: Community stats (CoinGecko no longer returns Twitter follower counts). Present when the community section is requested.

developer.description: Developer activity. Present when the developer section is requested.

commits4w.description: Commits in the last 4 weeks, when available.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `coin_not_found`: Upstream returned 404 for the slug — it is not a recognized CoinGecko id. `unsupported_currency`: Market data was selected, the coin has no quote key, and the supported-currency catalog excludes the code. `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_invalid_params`: CoinGecko rejected the request parameters with HTTP 400. `upstream_validation_failed`: CoinGecko rejected request validation with HTTP 422. `upstream_unauthorized`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 401, including credential or historical-window restrictions. `upstream_forbidden`: CoinGecko denied access with HTTP 402 or 403. `upstream_not_found`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 404 on an endpoint without a domain-specific missing result. `upstream_invalid_request`: CoinGecko rejected the HTTP request with another permanent client status or redirect. `upstream_conflict`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 409, 423, or 424. `upstream_timeout`: A CoinGecko attempt timed out or returned HTTP 408, 425, or 504. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The coin-detail request, conditional currency lookup, and their retries exceeded one 50-second deadline. `upstream_deadline`: An externally supplied deadline expired during the CoinGecko exchange. `upstream_http_error`: CoinGecko returned permanent HTTP 501 Not Implemented. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a transient 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

links.description: Official and social links. Present when the links section is requested.

repos.description: Source-code repository URLs (GitHub/Bitbucket; may be empty).

market.description: Market data in vs_currency. Present when the market section is requested.

currentPrice.description: Current price in vs_currency, when available.

fullyDilutedValuation.description: Fully diluted valuation in vs_currency, when available.

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in vs_currency, when available.

priceChangePct.description: Multi-window price change percentages in vs_currency; zero is preserved, null/missing values are omitted. USD may use a legacy scalar only when its entire currency map is absent.

profile.description: Identity and descriptive metadata. Present when the profile section is requested.

categories.description: Category display names (e.g. "Layer 1 (L1)") — not category_id slugs.

sentiment.description: Sentiment vote split. Present when the sentiment section is requested.

downPercentage.description: Percentage of down votes, when available.

upPercentage.description: Percentage of up votes, when available.
